site.name: Centennial Tunnel
site.location: Gold Hill Mining District, Boulder County
overview: Centennial Tunnel is a documented historic mine-tunnel locality in Boulder County's Gold Hill Mining District, preserved in mineral-locality records under several historic names.

timeline.text: The Centennial Tunnel locality formed part of the Gold Hill district's extensive network of hard-rock mine and tunnel workings.

moreHistory: Mineral-locality records place the Boulder County Centennial Tunnel occurrence near 40.03556, -105.47278 and associate it with names including Gov. Routt, Continental, Bismark, Bluebell Shaft & Tunnel, Canton, Mammoth, and Scandia.
This Boulder County locality is distinct from the separate Centennial Tunnel in the Upper Blue River Mining District near Park County.
